sources.title: Topic no. 701, Sale of your home
sources.authorityNotes: IRS's own tax topic, raw HTML cached. Page reads 'Page Last Reviewed or Updated: 09-Nov-2026', four days before access. States the $250,000/$500,000 exclusion and the ownership and use tests without naming a tax year.
sources.stalenessRisk: MEDIUM. The exclusion amounts are set by statute and have been stable, but Congress can change them. Re-read before republication and when the 2026 Publication 523 appears.

sources.title: Publication 523 (2025), Selling Your Home
sources.authorityNotes: IRS's own publication, raw HTML cached. This is the 2025 edition, 'For use in preparing 2025 Returns'; page reads 'Page Last Reviewed or Updated: 30-Apr-2026'. No 2026 edition existed on 2026-11-13.
sources.stalenessRisk: MEDIUM. Reissued each year. A sale closing in 2026 is reported on a 2026 return, for which the 2026 edition (expected early 2027) will be the governing publication. Re-read then.

sources.title: Publication 551 (12/2025), Basis of Assets
sources.authorityNotes: IRS's own publication, raw HTML cached. Header reads 'Revised: December 2025'; page reads 'Page Last Reviewed or Updated: 30-Apr-2026'. A continuous-use revision, not tied to one tax year.
sources.stalenessRisk: LOW to MEDIUM. Check the revision line before republishing.

sources.title: Topic no. 703, Basis of assets
sources.authorityNotes: IRS's own tax topic, raw HTML cached. Page reads 'Page Last Reviewed or Updated: 09-Nov-2026'. Sends readers to Publication 551 for property acquired by gift or inheritance.

sources.title: Topic no. 409, Capital gains and losses
sources.authorityNotes: IRS's own tax topic, raw HTML cached. Page reads 'Page Last Reviewed or Updated: 09-Nov-2026' but its rate paragraph and income thresholds are stated 'For taxable years beginning in 2025'. No 2026 thresholds were on the page at access.
sources.stalenessRisk: HIGH for the rate figures. Income thresholds are indexed every year and the page lags a tax year. Re-read in early 2027 for taxable years beginning in 2026.

sources.title: Capital Gains (individual income tax guidance)
sources.authorityNotes: Idaho State Tax Commission's own guidance page, raw HTML cached. Footer reads 'last updated: June 14, 2023'. Carries the Commission's disclaimer that the page is general guidance and that current tax law governs in a conflict. Cites Idaho Code 63-3022H and Income Tax Rules 170 to 173 (the rules were not read).

sources.title: Form CG, Capital Gains Deduction, and Instructions (2025)
